command: PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 COVERAGE_FILE=/private/tmp/geode-watch-deadline.coverage /private/tmp/geode-status-venv/bin/python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_manual_watch_http.py tests/test_manual_watch_http_deadlines.py --cov=geode.pipeline.manual_watch_http --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing

findings.scope: Conflicting Transfer-Encoding and Content-Length at a retained-body cap
findings.observed: A real local HTTPResponse accepted four bytes of an eight-byte chunked body as complete when conflicting Content-Length was four and the cap was four.
findings.resolution: Root added validate_framing to both real Response construction and injected request paths; retained in the frozen helper and covered by the combined focused suite.

findings.scope: Complete header/trailer parser operation, late EOF and completion
findings.observed: A local socket-pair response supplied exact baseline PDF bytes plus slow chunk trailers. Before repair it finished in 1.846214 seconds despite a one-second deadline, was marked complete/unchanged, and passed adapter verification.
findings.resolution: A bounded operation watchdog now shuts down an independently retained descriptor; it is cancelled and joined on every exit. Post-read and final classification refuse late completion. Original reproduction after repair retained the prior body, reported timeout/partial in 1.013505 seconds, and the adapter returned stopped/transport_error with a valid stopped receipt. The wire producer received BrokenPipe because shutdown was intentional.

findings.observed: Injected seal failure left report.json without RUN_MANIFEST.json; replay failed instead of finalizing.
findings.resolution: Sent to adapter owner Plato for a separate repair; this helper receipt does not certify that adapter fix.

findings.scope: Dispatch expires between adapter preflight and run initialization
findings.observed: A zero-request stopped report lacked run.json and failed its own verifier.
findings.resolution: Sent to adapter owner Plato; independent final adapter review remains separate.

limits: No public HTTP, DNS, TLS session, source acquisition or legal-currentness review was performed by these tests. Real framing tests use only local AF_UNIX socket pairs; transport endpoint dependencies are mocked.
The source adapter was changing concurrently and is not frozen by this receipt. Its pending recovery/custody/CLI findings were reported to its owner.
Retained-body accounting is not a count of all HTTP/TLS wire bytes. Earlier accepted blocks remain immutable when a subsequent operation times out.
The timer is an operational bound, subject to OS scheduling and cleanup latency; it does not claim mathematical zero overshoot. Late returns cannot be classified complete.

Reproduction scripts preserve the reviewed pre-fix cases and import repository fixture helpers. They are audit inputs, not standalone public collectors and not promises that a fixed implementation still produces the prior failure.
This package records a focused suite only; no full repository suite or live watch was run.
